about.en: Agency is a Solana launchpad for "autonomous coins": every token launched through it is paired with an AI reasoning model that watches its own market, sets missions, runs experiments, trades and rewards holders, acting only through a deterministic policy engine and an isolated signer. AGENCY is the platform's own token, the SPL mint 7VertkgF9KLhxxJXHX6uaWuoYZTP9LdGj2bWmVXVpump on Solana; 15% of the fees each launched coin generates buys back and burns it.
